summary: Phase 5a partially implemented. Created VecEADecomposition.lean with syntactic V-EA negation infrastructure (neg_bracket_syn, neg_vecEA2_syn, nf_exist_as_monadic bridge). The sorry-free nf_exist_as_monadic bridge confirms that NF existence problems reduce to MonadicFormula evaluation.
